core.problem: Select costly tests until all remaining hypotheses are contained in one overlapping action-success region.
core.mechanism: Grouping by region memberships; expected splitting-hyperedge weight cutting; stops at decision readiness, not exact hypothesis identity.
core.innovation: Decision regions can overlap, avoiding forced disjoint equivalence-class assignment.
core.experiment_protocol: MovieLens ratings embedded by SVD then cluster overlap; robot 10 environments x 100 sampled true hypotheses, 2000 hypotheses, 50 decision regions, 150 guarded moves.
core.results: Paper reports HEC reduces queries against several baselines; robot short-horizon experiment says myopic VoI essentially matches HEC. Not a movement-time benchmark.
limitations: Deterministic noise-free finite hypothesis model and prior.
Worst-case implementation O(|G|^k).

core.problem: Adaptively cover a random known-distribution scenario at minimum expected test or metric-route cost.
core.mechanism: Expected scenario-splitting mass plus normalized remaining coverage gain divided by test cost; routing uses submodular orienteering subroutine.
core.innovation: Separates scenario identification and scenario completion, allows correlated scenario feedback; general adaptive metric routing extension.
core.experiment_protocol: 415 chemical hypotheses,79 symptoms,10 datasets fill unknown responses; uniform and three power-law priors; unit test cost, ODT/generalizedODT.
core.results: ASR and greedy often close on WISER, neither uniformly best; synthetic instances show greedy can be poor. No physical robot routing experiment reported in read experimental section.
limitations: Finite explicitly known scenario probabilities.
Each scenario requires monotone submodular completion and deterministic feedback.
Metric routing theorem needs budgeted orienteering subroutine and fixed metric model.
Coverage completion cost can stop before algorithm knows completion in generic formulation; application stopping certificate must be established.
core.transfer: Audit that proposed information value changes downstream completion; distinguish fixed sensing cost from dynamic route cost. Do not transplant approximation factor to B task.
core.validation: Inspect actual paid movement/sensing and complete task outcomes; no weighted cross-question score; theory prerequisite checklist in memo.

core.problem: Verify that every point and facing direction in a field has a nearby camera with sufficient viewing angle.
core.mechanism: Cyclic adjacent-view angle gaps; partition by common covering sensors, then continuous boundary tests with safe/unsafe geometric regions; grid sufficient conditions require explicit radial/angular margin.
core.innovation: Coverage includes target-facing direction, not just sensor field of view or k-disk coverage.
core.experiment_protocol: Full-area tests100 repetitions; camera r5/25m, FoV60deg,effective angles30/45/60deg, enlarged deployment region removes boundary effect. Barrier at least500 repetitions.
core.results: Reports density/probability and covered-area fraction; high fractional coverage requires fewer cameras than guaranteed full-area coverage. Neither task-time nor B3 21-station optimality is tested.
limitations: Effective angle theta<pi/2; B task uses closed theta=pi/2 endpoint.
Camera FoV/radius and boundary conventions differ.
Safe-arc construction degenerates at endpoint; must separately prove halfplane/convex-hull condition.
Barrier coverage for moving intruders is insufficient for every static source in B task.
Random uniform density assumptions do not establish deterministic B3 full coverage.
core.transfer: Channel-specific actual measured no-signal points plus retained future stations must certify every B3 leaf via shared-neighbor convex hull; only then remove a future station.
core.validation: First count useful genuinely measured unknown-channel points and deletion opportunities on new development; then parent/dynamic-prune/paid-opportunistic-scan ablations with saved leaf certificates and full task checks.

core.title: Submodular Surrogates for Value of Information
core.venue: Proceedings of the Twenty-Ninth AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence,29(1),3511-3518

actual_reading.sections: Introduction; problem statement; ECD/DRD construction; Noisy-OR; graph coloring; noise handling; all4 experiments; conclusion
actual_reading.not_read: Supplement not acquired or read; p8 references inspected only

core.problem: Minimize paid tests until a near-maximal-utility decision can be identified, represented by overlapping decision regions.
core.mechanism: Decision-region EC2 partition graphs; normalized residual edge weights combined with Noisy-OR; greedy expected gain per test cost; graph coloring reduces graph count.
core.innovation: Continuous intermediate decision progress without enumerating HEC high-order hyperedges.
benchmarks: Touch-based button-pushing localization,20,000 pose hypotheses,simulated and real-robot demonstration
EMP whooping cranes management,8 hypotheses/7 strategies/noise expansion
core.experiment_protocol: Compares DIRECt,HEC,myopic VoI,GBS/EC2 and their DRD stopping variants; settings vary by task and are not directly B-task-time benchmarks.
core.results: Body reports DIRECt broadly competitive and cheaper to compute than HEC; in short-horizon robot case myopic VoI remains comparable. Real-robot success-rate denominator not supplied in read body; video/supplement not verified.
limitations: Fixed finite prior/test outcome model and positive per-test cost; continuous source geometry and state-dependent travel do not satisfy this model directly.
Noisy-OR of arbitrary adaptive-submodular functions is not generally adaptive submodular; lemma is for this particular construction.
Efficient special noise model is bounded binary-label flips, not automatically fixed spatial bearing noise.
No approximation factor or original runtime claim transferred to our policy.
core.transfer: Small shared position hypotheses and clear candidate sets for parent-cost/multi-hypothesis-cost/DIRECt-style surrogate ablations; retain continuous P and fallback.
core.validation: Record hypothesis/candidate computation budget; independent legal development, frozen quick/full/4800; no promise of beneficial completion time.
core.causal_note: Read after R2 R3 frozen; this link is explanatory context and future experiment proposal, not an origin claim for R3.
